summary: One-church Latin Mass community at St. Thomas the Apostle, Rochester. Sunday 9:00 AM English and 11:15 AM Latin Masses are settled; Sunday Confession after the 11:15 Mass is settled at 12:15 PM by POLICY's relative-time rule. Two open questions: the website-only Monday-Friday adoration chapel hours (leaning include) and website-homepage-only Confession after the 9:00 Mass (leaning leave out).

slots.rationale:
R29, C9 (leaning per C9): the bulletins list an Adoration Chapel contact but no hours; the hours are only on the website. The chapel is attached to the parish center beside the church, so POLICY puts it at St. Thomas the Apostle. Leaning include: the website is explicit and the bulletin confirms the chapel exists; nothing contradicts it. A 9 AM-10 PM open chapel may be perpetual-style adoration (sign-up), so a reviewer should confirm it is public Exposition.
